correctness.rationale: Reconstructed the independent query-point hit probability p(X)=product of uniform[0,1] coordinates, hence -log p~Gamma(d,1); the maximum of m independent exponentials gives exact E C=P(G_d<=M_m). Gamma Edgeworth CDF plus E(M_m-log m)=gamma+O(1/m) yields the displayed plus-gamma and plus-(1-s^2)/3 terms in the expected profile; inversion changes their sign. Changing one translate changes union volume by <=1, so McDiarmid gives exp(-2t²4^d/m); at m~exp(d+O(sqrt d)), t=d^-1 gives summable tails, and a rational-epsilon sandwich plus monotonicity proves a.s. convergence without cross-d independence. Recomputed exact mean from inclusion-exclusion: (d,m)=(2,3):23/48, (3,4):5981/18000, (4,5):95419/432000. These finite checks are not the infinite proof.
